name: Witch’s Broom (Minor Artifact)
body:
Aura moderate illusion, strong transmutation; CL 20th Slot none; Price —; Weight 3 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This racing broom of flying also functions as a staff of feast and famine and a +3 flying light mace. When flying, it can carry any load. Fire can’t destroy the broom; it actually gains +10 fly speed for every 10 minutes it is put on a fire. Lastly, the broom can cast greater invisibility at will and mythic time stop 1/day. In the hands of anyone other than it’s creator, it behaves as a broom of animated attack.

DESTRUCTION

The broom falls to ashes if used to deliver gifts to 300 bad children and coal to 300 good children in one night.
